summary: An empty cerca whose --data upper bound falls within the last 45 days warns that the gap may be source latency and points to `sync coverage`.
reason: The empty result and the source coverage lived in two commands: `interrogazioni cerca --data 2026-08-15:2026-09-04` returned [] with no signal while the archive stopped on 2026-08-03. Attaching `sync coverage` itself would cost a live request per call (~7s), so the hint is static and names the command.
validated_outcome: latenzaHint fires only on zero rows with an ISO --data whose window touches the last 45 days: a window starting in the future stays silent and one straddling today is clamped to today (unit test with fixed clock); live: the hint appears on stderr and inside --envelope for interrogazioni/resoconti, stays silent on a 2020 window and on a 2027 window.
